facts.statement: The Sanctuary Trick or Treat party ran on Thursday 21 October 2010 at 15:00 Pacific Time for US and Latin America, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Jueves 21 de octubre del 2010 15 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico (EE.UU. y Latino América) Servidor 1

facts.statement: A second Sanctuary Trick or Treat session ran on Friday 22 October 2010 at 09:00 Pacific Time (16:00 European time) for UK and Europe, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Viernes 22 de octubre del 2010 09:00 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico / 16:00 hrs. Tiempo Europeo (UK y Europa) Servidor 1

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta de Truco o Trato en Santuario
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice (captured under the 'What is New?' page) announcing a Trick or Treat party in Sanctuary to celebrate the second anniversary of the Super Spooktacular edition. It gives the event dates and server (Server 1) for the US/Latin America and UK/Europe sessions in October 2010. The article's own posting date is not shown; only the event dates are given.
